headline: Daily Market Snapshot – August 3, 2026
summary: US equity futures rose in premarket as Trump's Iran ceasefire announcement sent oil ~5% lower. Gold firmed above $4,050, the dollar weakened, Treasury yields eased, and BTC traded near $63,300.

headline: Oil drops to 3-week low as Trump calls off Iran strike, announces fresh Hormuz peace talks
summary: President Trump announced over the weekend that he called off a planned strike on Iran after diplomatic overtures, citing agreement on terms including Hormuz Strait reopening. WTI crude fell 4.9% to $80.50 and Brent dropped 4.8% to $83.68 — their lowest in three weeks. Iran's Foreign Ministry denied ongoing talks with the US.
key_facts: Trump called off planned Iran strike over the weekend
Proposed terms: immediate complete opening of Hormuz Strait plus end to Iran nuclear threat
Brent crude Oct futures -4.8% to $83.68 (3-week low)
Iran Foreign Ministry denied ongoing negotiations with US
Brent had topped $100 in late July on Houthi Saudi tanker attacks

headline: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures rise as Trump calls off Iran attack, oil and bond yields ease
summary: US equity futures gained Monday as Trump's Iran announcement eased geopolitical risk and pushed oil sharply lower. S&P 500 futures were up 0.63%, Nasdaq 100 +0.59%, and Dow +0.49%. August kicks off with a busy earnings week and a Friday jobs report.
key_facts: Palantir reports Q2 after close Monday
SpaceX reports first-ever public earnings Tuesday

headline: Gold firms above $4,050 as oil slumps after Trump holds off on Iran attack
summary: Spot gold rose 0.4% to $4,055.36/oz on Monday as oil prices plunged on Trump's Iran ceasefire announcement. Lower oil eased near-term inflation fears, reducing pressure on the gold price from high real rates. US gold futures edged 0.2% higher to $4,054.20.
key_facts: Oil selloff eases near-term inflation fears
Gold was below $4,000 mid-July amid high real rates
Central bank demand remains structural support
Oil decline reduces Fed hike probability near-term

headline: WTI slides to $80.50 and Brent to $83.68 — 3-week lows — on Iran ceasefire news
summary: WTI crude fell 4.9% to $80.50/bbl and Brent dropped 4.8% to $83.68 in Asian trading Monday, reaching 3-week lows after Trump said he called off a planned Iran attack. The WTI chart shows a head-and-shoulders pattern with the head above $86 and neckline near $79.72; a break below could target the low $70s.
key_facts: Head-and-shoulders pattern on WTI: head ~$86, neckline ~$79.72
Measured-move target low $70s on neckline break
Brent topped $100 during Houthi Saudi tanker attacks late July

summary: Palantir reports Q2 2026 results after the close Monday with consensus at $1.812B revenue and $0.34 EPS. The company has beaten estimates for 8 consecutive quarters. Stock at $123, down 40% from peak; ~71x sales, ~113x forward earnings

summary: AMD reports Q2 2026 results on August 4 after close. The company guided $11.2B revenue at 56% non-GAAP gross margins (~46% YoY growth). MI450 accelerator ramp and Helios rack-scale platform are the primary read-throughs for AI demand, underpinned by 6GW GPU agreements with OpenAI and Meta.

headline: Bitcoin at $63,326 as August Begins; $60K Support Key After 50% Drop From Oct 2025 Peak
summary: Bitcoin was trading near $63,326 on August 3 after recovering ~13% from June lows but failing to hold above $65,500 in late July. BTC closed July around $63,700. The crypto has lost nearly half its value since peaking at $126K in October 2025, with the $60K support having broken briefly in June (low of $59,100). Iran peace optimism provided mild risk-on support.
key_facts: Recovery ~13% off June lows through July
$65,000-$70,000 is key resistance zone per analysts

headline: Ethereum Begins August Near $1,867 With Cautious Recovery; Market Cap ~$225B
summary: Ethereum was trading around $1,867 at the start of August 2026, with a market capitalization of approximately $225B. ETH's intraday range was contained between $1,850 and $1,890 on weak volume. The $2,000 level remains a key resistance zone. ETH has been under pressure alongside broader crypto weakness.
key_facts: Weak trading volume limits conviction in recovery

headline: US Dollar Index Falls to 99.72 as Iran Peace Optimism Reduces Inflation Anxiety
summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY) slipped to 99.72 on August 3 (-0.19%), as Trump's Iran ceasefire announcement sent oil prices lower and eased near-term inflation anxiety. The dollar is broadly softer, down 1.13% over the past month but up 0.95% over the past 12 months.
key_facts: Dollar broadly softer on oil-driven inflation relief

headline: USD/JPY Slides to 156.51 After Japan Finance Ministry Confirms Coordinated Yen-Buying With US Treasury
summary: USD/JPY fell to 156.51 on August 3 (-0.59%), bringing the yen's appreciation to roughly 5% over three sessions following Japan's Finance Ministry confirmation of coordinated yen-buying with the US Treasury the prior week. USD/JPY had been near 163 before the intervention triggered the move to 158 on July 31.
key_facts: Japan Finance Ministry confirmed coordinated yen-buying with US Treasury
USD/JPY was near 163 before July 31 BOJ/Finance Ministry operation
BOJ held policy rate at 1% on July 31

summary: Macquarie downgraded Roblox (RBLX) to Neutral from Outperform and cut the price target to $37 from $80 on July 31, citing age-check friction, monetization pressure from algorithm changes, difficult 2025 comps, and accelerating AI/infrastructure investment. RBLX hit a near two-year low and Q3 bookings are guided to decline 14-18%.

Mizuho lowered its price target to $155 from $200, while Oppenheimer maintained Outperform but trimmed its target to $193 from $209. The stock was trading near $178 before the miss. Despite the pullback, 44 analysts keep an average target of $241 with a Buy consensus.

The July rout was driven by DeepSeek competition fears, IBM AI hardware cannibalization (-25% in a single session), Samsung Q2 revenue miss, and AI valuation reset concerns before a sharp late-month recovery triggered by Lam Research and MSFT earnings.

Samsung Q2 revenue miss worsened sentiment mid-July

61% of S&P 500 companies reported as of Jul 31

headline: Paramount Skydance Wins Warner Bros. Discovery for ~$111B After Netflix Walks Away in February 2026
summary: Netflix's December 2025 agreement to acquire WBD was terminated February 27, 2026, after WBD's board accepted Paramount Skydance's superior $31/share ($111B EV) offer. Netflix received a $2.8B termination fee. WBD shareholders approved the Paramount deal in April and DOJ cleared it in May 2026, with remaining approvals still pending.

Paramount Skydance won with $31/share ($111B EV including debt)
WBD shareholders approved Paramount deal April 2026
DOJ cleared deal May 2026; additional regulatory approvals pending

headline: Fed Holds 3.50%-3.75% Under Warsh for 9th Straight Meeting; Rate Hike Odds Alive as Inflation Stays Elevated
summary: The Federal Reserve held the federal funds rate at 3.50%-3.75% in late July (9th consecutive hold, 9-3 vote) under Chairman Kevin Warsh. Cut projections were pushed to 2027-2028 while the median year-end rate projection of 3.8% leaves a hike on the table. The hold triggered a bond market selloff with the 30-year yield hitting a 19-year high of 5.23%.

Warsh introduced 5 new policy-review task forces
